non_residential_details.development_type: Change of Use with Extension(s) over 999sqm

description: Retention, alteration and extension of International House (7507m2 gross external floorspace) and its use as shops (A1 use class), restaurants (A3 use class) and B1A (office use) floorspace (as compared to planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8 December 2006, overall reduction of 1047sqm gross external area but increase of 79sqm gross internal area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Samples of the render and louver screen to be used in the construction of the external surfaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005, any A1 floorspace shall only be used as a sandwich bar and/or internet caf? and for no other purpose falling within A1.
Condition : 5 - No individual A1 or A3 unit shall exceed 500m2 gross external area and no units shall be amalgamated or consolidated to create a unit or units in excess of 500m2 gross external area.
Condition : 6 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the building by means of internal horizontal division without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am to 6.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and 8.30am to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.  No construction vehicles shall access the site from/egress onto the Great West Road between the hours of 7.00am to 10.00am and 4.00pm to 7.00pm.

Condition : 8 - No A1 unit shall be open to customers outside the following times: 7.00am to 11.00pm weekdays (Monday-Friday) and Saturday and 11.00am to 11.00pm on Sundays, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11.00pm every day.

Condition : 9 - No A3 unit shall be open to customers outside the following times: 9.00am to 11.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and on Saturdays, and 11.00am to 11.00pm on Sundays, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11.00pm every day.

Condition : 10 - No amplified or other music shall be played in any unit hereby permitted for A1/A3 use outside the following times: 11.00am to 11.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays), Saturdays and Sundays, and none shall be audible outside of the unit without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - No commercial deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 22.00 hours Monday to Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 12 - International House shall not be occupied until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials (including details of the means and timing of collections and, in relation to proposed bin areas, access and pulling distance details) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and completed.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
Condition : 13 - Access doorways shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground or floor level as relevant.

Condition : 14 - Notwithstanding Condition 2, before any A1/A3 unit opens to customers, the detailed design of the shop front for that unit shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 15 - The A1/A3 units shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises and shall not extend to the delivery of food and/or drink to customers by vehicle unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - Before any A3 use commences a scheme for control of fumes and odours from the relevant premises including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 17 - Before any A3 use commences a scheme for the ventilation of the relevant premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 18 - Any scheme approved under Condition 16 (Control of fumes - details) shall be fully implemented before teh A3 use opens to customers.
Condition : 19 - Any scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 17 (Ventilation equipment - details) shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 20 - Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the building shall not be occupied until details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works carried out as approved.  

These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

All hard landscape works shall be retained thereafter.

Condition : 21 - Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the building shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the building is occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 22 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the building for its permitted use or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 23 - If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.
Condition : 24 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the development hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 25 - The parts of the development for which A1/A3 and B1 uses have been permitted shall not be first used until details of measures to prevent light spill from the illumination of the interior of the premises have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 26 - The building shall not be occupied until details of the vehicle access points from Ealing Road, Clayponds Lane and the service road parallel to the Great West Road have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the access arrangements completed as approved (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority).  The access arrangements shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 27 - The building shall not be occupied until details of sightlines at the points of access to the public highway have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be fully implemented prior to the occupation of the building (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) and retained thereafter.

Condition : 28 - The 11 parking spaces, four short stay delivery bays and 16 cycle spaces shown on approved drawing A1959 C 0200 P3 (GA Ground Floor Planning Application) shall have been laid out in accordance with that drawing and available for use before occupation of International House, and such spaces shall thereafter be retained (shall not be used for any other purposes).  There shall be no more than the approved 11 parking spaces and four short stay delivery bays laid out within the site for use by the occupiers of/visitors to International House.
